}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== Device also references ID 0b3b:1601 with the same device description :("ZyAIR B-200 Wireless LAN USB Adapter"). P/N '''AM5017-004''' Unknown what the differences were between the units, if any.
Drivers reference the device as 0b3b:1602 for v2.5 and also 0b3b:1603 for v3.0 :(which appears to be used by the [[ZyXEL ZyAIR B-200]]).
The FCC ID is probably O6M-UW250 ([[BroMax UW250‎]]). *{{WiFiCert|W000844|03/03/2003}}
